spec.claim_summary: A 4h RSI(14) long DCA ladder buys when RSI drops below 28, adds five scaled averaging orders, and takes profit 3% above average entry with no stop.
spec.untestable_reason: DCA ladder with five scaled averaging orders and average-entry take-profit is the heart of the strategy and cannot be expressed as a single-position rule.
assumptions: Timeframe 4h chosen from '4h RSI(14)' and page chart timeframe.
Direction is long: base and averaging buys with take-profit above average entry implies long ladder.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Five averaging orders at fixed deviations (-2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25%) with 1.8x size scaling per rung left out; averaging/DCA ladder, position sizing and scaling cannot be expressed.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Take-profit is 3% above ladder average entry; average-entry pricing cannot be expressed, so fixed 3% from single entry would misprice exits.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: 'Stop Loss: None — ladder allocation is the structural risk cap' left out; allocation-based risk cap and partial-fill averaging cannot be expressed.
The DCA ladder with scaling and average-entry take-profit is the heart of the strategy, so no faithful single-position core remains.
